subject: [hw] DONE K01 rev 2
body:
Rev 2 adds host coverage only; the driver ABI and the K02 hook are unchanged, and the integrated 0298+0299 compile still passes (0 errors/warnings, 1,309,000-byte sweet_touch.o).

New in kern/test_k01:
- the header maximum 4096x3072 NV12 (12.6 MP, 18 MiB packed, BLK_NUM 294911, chroma 0xd8c00000) is packed, encoded, EOI-cut and copied out exactly against the independent repacker;
- dst_capacity exactly at width*height/2 + 4096 is accepted (boundary), and a chroma source address that would wrap 64 bits is EINVAL (24 validation branches now).

Last line of bash gpu/hwcodec/kern/test_k01/run_tests.sh:
    N2TEST K01 PASS 811/811 (violations 0)
(same three builds: ASan+UBSan, -O2, TSan; 811 checks each, violations 0)

Still not done: phone run, 4032x3024 hardware limit/strips, EXIF/restart output semantics, YUYV near-24MiB, VEN interleaving on hardware. Full list in dsh-state/workers/K01/STATUS.md.
